en.book.hint: One book per group: put the world setting (timeline / factions / geography / power / daily) here and keep only character-private entries in each member card. Two export formats: the CCv3 standalone lorebook (lorebook_v3, for clients that support the spec) and the SillyTavern lorebook (ST's importer only accepts the {entries:{…}} shape — feeding it the CCv3 file answers Bad Request).
en.book.name: Book name
en.book.noGroup: Shared lorebooks live on a group: create one under “Saved characters” on the right and put the member cards in it.
en.book.promoteHint: Move these N entries into the shared book and delete them from every card — do this before exporting and the cards hold no duplicates.
en.book.promotePreview: Will promote {n} and delete {m} duplicates across the cards
en.book.promoteSyncedDraft: Current draft synced — removed {n} duplicates (saving would have written them back)
en.book.title: Shared lorebook
en.export.book.hint: The shared setting of this card's group can be exported on its own: the CCv3 standalone lorebook for clients that support lorebook_v3, and the SillyTavern lorebook in ST's native shape ({entries:{…}}) — ST's importer accepts nothing else, so feeding it the CCv3 file answers Bad Request. In ST, import the lorebook first and the card second: the card carries the binding automatically (data.extensions.world); the entries inside the card still need one “Import Card Lore” click.
en.export.book.merge: Merge the shared entries into this card when exporting JSON (for clients without a global lorebook)
